extracted.intended_audience: researchers, map historians, librarians, and general public seeking metadata and images for a historical map
extracted.subtask_description: A digital archive/catalog item page describing a historical map (title, creators, publication data, physical description, provenance, identifiers) and providing access/licensing information for image use and download.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image licensing and attribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Images may be downloaded and used following Creative Commons CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 license. Image credit should be given to "David Rumsey Map Collection, David Rumsey Map Center, Stanford Libraries." Please contact the David Rumsey Map Collection for commercial use. https://www.davidrumsey.com/about/copyright-and-permissions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must attribute the David Rumsey Map Collection and adhere to CC BY-NC-SA (non-commercial, share-alike) terms; commercial use requires contacting the collection for permission. Provide the specified credit line when reusing images.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access and download options
rubrics_metrics.description: Zoomable full resolution image available at davidrumsey.com. Download options shown on the item (JPEG, torrent, original files) with indicated item size (e.g., 5.5M) and multiple file records (this image 0875.001 part of image group 0875.000).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliver high-resolution access via the source (davidrumsey.com) and offer multiple download formats; surface file identifiers and sizes so users can find the full-resolution master.

rubrics_metrics.name: Descriptive metadata fields
rubrics_metrics.description: The item record includes title, creators (Robert Sayer and John Bennett; Dunn, Samuel), publication date (1776), topics (American Revolution), publisher, rights statement, item size, scanner, source URL, external identifiers (urn:davidrumsey:list-no, pub-list-no), identifier, call number, added date, and collections membership (David Rumsey Map Collection).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catalog entries should provide comprehensive metadata (bibliographic, topical, identifiers, collection, and technical fields) to support discovery, citation, and provenance tracking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Physical and contextual description / significance
rubrics_metrics.description: Descriptive notes on the physical item and its significance are provided: 'Map in outline color by European Power.' 'This small hand atlas has six early maps, three of which are particularly important to the mapping of the American Revolution...' Nicknamed the 'Holster Atlas' made for use by British army officers; condition/format notes (folded and bound into book with paper covered boards and quarter leather, stamped in gilt on the spine). Size listed as 31x44cm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include physical dimensions, binding/format details, content summaries, historical context, and bibliographic citations (P1206; Streeter 73; Nebenzahl Atlas references) to convey significance and aid researchers.
